title: cyrtomium hookerianum
intro: Cyrtomium hookerianum, commonly known as Holly Fern, is a type of fern plant that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of Cyrtomium hookerianum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
